caption:
Say this to a debt collector. 📞

"Please send me written validation of this debt."

A collector is generally required to send you details of the debt. Keep your own records, and check your situation with a professional.

Have you ever dealt with a collector call?
first_comment: What was the strangest thing a collector ever said to you? 👇
